data.name: Vidu3ImageToVideoNode
data.description: Generate a video from an image and an optional prompt.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.duration
input_details.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds.

input_details.name: model.audio
input_details.tooltip: When enabled, outputs video with sound (including dialogue and sound effects).

input_details.name: image
input_details.tooltip: An image to be used as the start frame of the generated video.

input_details.name: prompt
input_details.tooltip: An optional text prompt for video generation (max 2000 characters).
